{{Quote|Add the planet Khomm to the top of the list. Gather your forces and go at once.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala|Daala]]|<ref name="Darksaber" />}}
This '''attack on Khomm''' was a unilateral bombing of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Khomm/Legends|Khomm]] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] by the [[United Warlord Fleets]]' [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Ivan Cronus]], who commandeered the ''[[13X]]'' and [[Gender/Legends|his]] fleet of [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyers]] under the orders of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]].

This came as it was discovered that [[Dorsk 81]] and [[Kyp Durron]] had visited the planet. [[Dorsk 80]], Dorsk 81's predecessor, wished him to return to his old job, but 81 was simply trying to warn Khomm of the impending attack. Refusing to listen, the Khommites did nothing. Cronus carried out Daala's order with [[Crimson Command]], devastating the planet and its population.
